description: This file defines a custom exception class 'KeyHandlerException' within the OrangeHRM system, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances related to key handling operations.

classes.name: KeyHandlerException
classes.description: Custom exception class for key handling errors, extending the base PHP Exception class, and providing static methods for common error scenarios.

methods.name: keyAlreadyExists
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key already exists.

methods.name: failedToCreateKey
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating failure to create a key.

methods.name: keyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key file does not exist.

methods.name: keyIsNotReadable
methods.description: Returns an instance of KeyHandlerException indicating the key is not readable.

calls: new self('Key file does not exist')
